# pam_flutter

**Tag**: web, mobile, networking

## 简介

A Flutter plugin for integrating mobile Flutter app with PAM Real CDP. learn more about pam at https://pams.ai

## 官网

- 主页: https://pams.ai
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/3dsinteractive/pamflutter
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/pam_flutter
